scope: September-origin signals/events, September daily prices, outcomes available at database snapshot; dark-pool execution month in ET

snapshot.sql: SELECT now() AS snapshot_at, current_date AS server_date, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation

confidence_pooled_5d.sql: WITH signal_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signal_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), options_flow_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), squeeze_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.squeeze_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prebreakout_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.prebreakout_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prices AS (SELECT * FROM public.prices WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_prints AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 04:00:00' AND executed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 04:00:00') SELECT floor(confidence/10)*10 AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_5d) AS wins, min(confidence) AS lo, max(confidence) AS hi FROM signal_outcomes WHERE confidence IS NOT NULL AND return_5d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

confidence_pooled_market.sql: WITH signal_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signal_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), options_flow_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), squeeze_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.squeeze_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prebreakout_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.prebreakout_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prices AS (SELECT * FROM public.prices WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_prints AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 04:00:00' AND executed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 04:00:00') SELECT horizon, signal_direction, CASE WHEN confidence>=0 AND confidence<40 THEN '0-40' WHEN confidence<55 AND confidence>=40 THEN '40-55' WHEN confidence<70 AND confidence>=55 THEN '55-70' WHEN confidence<85 AND confidence>=70 THEN '70-85' WHEN confidence<101 AND confidence>=85 THEN '85+' ELSE 'outside' END AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct) AS wins FROM signal_outcomes WHERE is_correct IS NOT NULL AND signal_date>=current_date-180 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

flow_5d_clusters.sql: WITH signal_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signal_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), options_flow_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), squeeze_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.squeeze_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prebreakout_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.prebreakout_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prices AS (SELECT * FROM public.prices WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_prints AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 04:00:00' AND executed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 04:00:00') SELECT direction,symbol,fired_date, count(*) AS contracts, avg(return_5d) AS ret, min(entry_date) AS entry_date, avg(CASE WHEN is_correct_5d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS win_fraction FROM options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE return_5d IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

dark_daily.sql: WITH signal_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signal_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), options_flow_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), squeeze_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.squeeze_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prebreakout_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.prebreakout_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prices AS (SELECT * FROM public.prices WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_prints AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 04:00:00' AND executed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 04:00:00'), p AS (SELECT (executed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, count(*) AS prints, count(DISTINCT symbol) AS observed_symbols FROM dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at>=DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT fired_date AS day, count(*) AS alerts, count(DISTINCT symbol) AS alert_symbols FROM dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date>=DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(p.day,a.day) AS day, prints,observed_symbols,alerts,alert_symbols FROM p FULL JOIN a USING(day) ORDER BY day

prebreakout.sql: WITH signal_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signal_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), options_flow_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), squeeze_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.squeeze_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prebreakout_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.prebreakout_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prices AS (SELECT * FROM public.prices WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_prints AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 04:00:00' AND executed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 04:00:00') SELECT symbol,count(*) AS n,count(return_5d) AS resolved_5d,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct_5d) AS wins_5d,avg(return_5d) AS ret_5d,count(return_20d) AS resolved_20d,avg(return_20d) AS ret_20d FROM prebreakout_alert_outcomes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

confidence_september.sql: WITH signal_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND signal_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), options_flow_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.options_flow_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), squeeze_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.squeeze_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prebreakout_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.prebreakout_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_alert_outcomes AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_alert_outcomes WHERE fired_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND fired_date < DATE '2026-10-01'), prices AS (SELECT * FROM public.prices WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-10-01'), dark_pool_prints AS (SELECT * FROM public.dark_pool_prints WHERE executed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 04:00:00' AND executed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 04:00:00') SELECT o.horizon, o.signal_direction, s.market, CASE WHEN confidence>=0 AND confidence<40 THEN '0-40' WHEN confidence<55 AND confidence>=40 THEN '40-55' WHEN confidence<70 AND confidence>=55 THEN '55-70' WHEN confidence<85 AND confidence>=70 THEN '70-85' WHEN confidence<101 AND confidence>=85 THEN '85+' ELSE 'outside' END AS band, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_correct) AS wins, count(DISTINCT o.symbol) AS symbols, count(DISTINCT signal_date) AS dates, avg(pct_return) AS raw_return FROM signal_outcomes o JOIN stocks s ON s.id=o.stock_id WHERE is_correct IS NOT NULL AND o.signal_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4
